label: Election office
description: A county or state election office (clerk, registrar, board of elections, supervisor of elections or the Secretary of State's elections division): voter registration, mail ballots, vote centers and drop boxes, certified voting systems at central count, election-night results reporting and the canvass. Scenarios use fictional jurisdictions, contests and candidates.

vocabulary.facility: the election office (the warehouse, central count, vote centers, drop boxes and the results-reporting site)
vocabulary.public: voters, observers and the candidates' representatives
vocabulary.frontline: poll workers, rovers, election technicians, mail-ballot processing staff, hotline staff, warehouse staff

it: statewide voter registration database and the county election management front end
online voter registration and polling-place lookup
ballot-on-demand printers and ballot layout software
mail-ballot tracking notifications and signature verification
hotline / call center and social media accounts
ot: precinct-count optical scanners and central-count high-speed scanners
the air-gapped election management system server
removable media and the results upload workstation

roles.name: Chief Election Official (Incident Commander)
roles.description: The county clerk, registrar or elections director: activates the contingency plan, relocates polling places, asks counsel to petition for extended hours, and speaks for the office.

roles.name: Deputy Director (Election-Day Operations Center)
roles.description: Runs the election-day operations center: hotline, rovers, staffing and logistics.

roles.name: Elections IT Manager / County CISO
roles.description: Owns e-pollbook networking, voter registration access, the results website and isolation decisions.

roles.name: Voting Systems Manager
roles.description: Owns logic and accuracy testing, tabulator chain of custody, seals and vendor escalation.

roles.name: Mail Ballot Manager
roles.description: Owns mail-ballot printing, USPS coordination, drop-box collection and signature verification.

roles.name: Facility Security Manager / Sheriff's Election Liaison
roles.description: Owns warehouse access, ballot transport escorts, threats to staff and protest response.

roles.name: Communications Director (PIO)
roles.description: Owns voter information, rumor control and results-reporting messages.

outsideParties: the Secretary of State / state election director
CISA (regional election security advisor, Cybersecurity Advisor)
USPS and the U.S. Postal Inspection Service
the DOJ Civil Rights Division (Voting Section)
the ballot printer and mail house
